source.title: Executor smoke test
source.description: Minimal 3-task / 2-layer DAG that exercises the full executor path end-to-end: a batched trivial layer, a standard worktree task, the inter-layer contract gate, and worktree merge. All work is scoped to smoke-out/ so a run is trivially disposable. Cheap (sonnet, tiny tasks).
acceptanceCriteria: smoke-out/alpha.txt exists and contains the single line: alpha
smoke-out/bravo.txt exists and contains the single line: bravo
smoke-out/combined.md lists the contents of both source files

tasks.name: Write alpha file
tasks.description: Create the file smoke-out/alpha.txt containing exactly one line with the text: alpha (no trailing blank lines, no other content). Use the Write tool. Do not modify any other file.

alpha.description: A text file whose sole line is the word alpha

tasks.name: Write bravo file
tasks.description: Create the file smoke-out/bravo.txt containing exactly one line with the text: bravo (no trailing blank lines, no other content). Use the Write tool. Do not modify any other file.

bravo.description: A text file whose sole line is the word bravo

tasks.name: Combine source files
tasks.description: Read smoke-out/alpha.txt and smoke-out/bravo.txt, then create smoke-out/combined.md containing a markdown bullet list with one bullet per source file in the form `- <filename>: <contents>`. Use the Read and Write tools. Do not modify the two source files.

combined.description: A markdown file listing the contents of alpha.txt and bravo.txt

executionLayers.description: Create the two source files (batched trivial session on the base branch)
Combine the source files (standard task in an isolated worktree, merged back)
